title: Build vs Buy Software in 2026: When Custom Beats Off-the-Shelf
summary: The build vs buy decision used to favor buying. AI changes the math: building custom takes hours now, not months. Here's the framework for deciding which path wins for your team.
body_markdown: The framework is the same; the weights differ. Enterprises care more about compliance audit trails and vendor support SLAs — buying wins in any category where SOC 2 or HIPAA certification from day one is required. Startups hit the $200/month threshold faster on fewer users, making the build case stronger earlier. Both should still buy payment processing, email infrastructure, and cloud hardware — those commodity layers are never worth building.[Blink](https://blink.new/) covers the internal-tools and customer-portal use cases well for both company sizes.
